title: FCC Internet Access Report: US Reaches 559 Million Connections, Fixed Broadband Growth at 135 Million
detail: The FCC's Office of Economics and Analytics published its semi-annual Internet Access Services Report on May 8, 2026 (covering data through June 30, 2025). Key findings: total US internet connections reached 559 million, up 1.9% year-over-year; mobile connections totaled 424 million (+1.9%); and fixed broadband connections grew to 135 million (+1.6%). The report was released in the context of ongoing BEAD program debates about whether satellite broadband or fiber should be prioritized for the final ~7 million unserved US locations. The Benton Institute's May 12 digest highlighted the report's data as a baseline for evaluating BEAD program effectiveness as implementation accelerates through 2026.

title: UK Project Gigabit Expands to 9,500 Additional Premises in Essex With £8.3M Government Funding
detail: The UK government's Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT) announced in the week of May 8, 2026 that an additional 9,500 rural and urban premises in Essex would be upgraded to gigabit-capable broadband under Project Gigabit, backed by £8.3 million in government funding with construction commencing immediately. The announcement brought UK gigabit availability to 90.63% and full-fibre availability to 84.24% of all premises — on track toward the government's 2030 target of universal gigabit coverage. Project Gigabit is the UK's largest-ever public investment in digital infrastructure, deploying gigabit-capable connections to locations not served commercially, primarily rural areas and market towns that would otherwise be excluded from the national upgrade.
